reason: Emmbi Industries is acquiring 50% of Britpac AB, which should expand its market reach and potentially increase revenue.
why_now: The Board approved the acquisition proposal on October 29, 2026, making this a live event.
source_headlines: Emmbi Industries Limited: Emmbi Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Board s approval, at its meeting held on October 29, 2026, of the proposal for acquisition of 50% of the equity share capital of Britpac AB, Sweden, operating under the trade name FortaPac , by Zastian Pte. Ltd., Singapore, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company.
